{{Quote|I've been a scout for TaggeCo. for the better part of a decade and I've blazed trails on worlds stretching from Chandrila to Kal'Shebbol.|Bynder Zebb|<ref name="SE" />}}
'''Bynder Zebb''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who spent their life as an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]], visiting planets such as [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], they left a negative comment about the [[M38-series explorer droid]] on the [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]."

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've been an Outer Rim scout for most of my life, and the idea that a droid can handle "all initial exploration duties" is a joke. A friend of mine used an M38 once. He'd been planetside all of a day when the droid&mdash;confused by too much sensor imput&mdash;fell off a cliff and was destroyed. Some help.|Bynder Zebb comments on the M38 Explorer Droid on "Cynabar's Droid Datalog"|<ref name="Droid">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
[[File:TaggeCo.svg|thumb|right|250px|Bynder Zebb worked for Tagge Company (logo pictured).]]
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Bynder Zebb<ref name="SE" /> was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for most of his life.<ref name="Droid" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Zebb had worked for nearly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] as a corporate scout for<ref name="SE" /> [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]], a diverse group primarily involved in heavy manufacturing and [[Mining/Legends|mining]].<ref name="css">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> Throughout their tenure with the company, Zebb visited many worlds, including<ref name="SE" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and<ref name="SE" /> the Outer Rim<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]]</ref> planet<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].<ref name="SE" /> 

Zebb was also a contributor on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-centered [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]." At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Zebb, logged as "Bynder/37:1:8:11/Slu" commented on the page for the [[M38-series explorer droid]] manufactured by [[LesTech]]. The Twi'lek found the idea of a droid handling "all initial exploration duties" humorous and detailed an incident where their [[Bynder Zebb's friend|friend's]] M38-series explorer droid fell of a cliff after not being able to handle it's sensor input.<ref name="Droid" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No, the toughest part io ''[sic]'' being a scout is the ''animals''. Every planet seems to have some kind of nasty creature that is just longing to pounce on you. Scouts always have to deal with predators that crawl, slither, and shamble, from under rocks, behind bushes or from tree branches. Forget hostile aliens (since you can usually reason with them); the monsters that lurk in the deep holes of an unknown world are the toughest part of the job.|Bynder Zebb|<ref name="SE" />}}
Zebb followed the logic that what one did not know could [[Death/Legends|kill]] them, and considered the animals found while scouting planets to be the hardest part of his job. Zebb stated that it seemed like every planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had an animal eager to attack and opined that hostile [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] were forgettable compared to animals, as they could be reasoned with. Though the scout found some animals, like the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] and [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]], to be useful creatures, Zebb still was wary of them due to their nature of trampling when scared. The Twi'lek had light skin.<ref name="SE" />

==Equipment==
Zebb wore a loose cream [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], gray pants, and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The Twi'lek additionally added to the outfit a black jacket, a brown [[Holster/Legends|holster]], fingerless black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and black wrappings around his head,<ref name="SE" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]],<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and upper [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. Zebb used a gray backpack, a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and [[Binoculars/Legends|binoculars]].<ref name="SE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bynder Zebb was first mentioned in ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', published by [[West End Games]]<ref name="Droid" /> in [[April]] of [[1997]].<ref name="DroidsSW.com">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/6495|text=Droids}}</ref> The character first received their surname in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', another West End Games product,<ref name="SE" /> published in [[October]] 1997.<ref name="SWGC1">{{CollectorCite|1|Playing A Major Role}}</ref>
